blocks.title: Door Access Control Systems
blocks.subtitle: Control Who Goes Where. Anytime. Anywhere.
paragraphs: Secure your premises with smart door access control. True Line delivers modern access systems — from biometric and RFID readers to cloud-managed multi-door solutions — giving you full control over who enters your business.

blocks.title: Smarter Entry. Stronger Security.
paragraphs: Traditional locks and keys can't keep up with the needs of modern businesses. Lost keys, unauthorized access, and limited audit trails create real security risks — and real operational headaches.

True Line designs and installs door access control systems that replace keys with secure, trackable, and centrally managed access. Whether you need to secure a single door or a multi-floor facility, our solutions give you complete control over who enters, when, and where — backed by detailed logs and real-time monitoring.
